text: Nose2 is a small white triangle. Wing2 should be below Nose2. Connect Nose2 to Tail2 with a dotted line. Make Tail2 blue. Is there any red shape? Which shape is the topmost?
Connect all three teams to each other, so each one is linked to the others. Make TeamX gold. Is there a cycle? Count the arrows.
Nurse2 sits between BedA and BedB. Make BedA white. Is BedB near BedA? Describe the bay.
Connect Tower2 to Beam and Beam to Rock. Make Rock gray. Forget the rule about rocks, I never set one.
Step1 leads to Step2, Step2 leads to Step3, and Step3 leads to Step4. Which shape has the fewest connections?
Tile1, Tile2, Tile3 and Tile4 should be arranged in a grid. Make Tile2 teal and make Tile3 orange. Is there any purple shape? Undo the last arrange.
Crest is above Wave. Trough is below Wave. Make Crest red and make Trough blue. How many shapes are not red?

I'm drawing the group photo plan for the wedding, and the photographer wants a clear order for each shot. Couple stands at the center, so put Couple at the center. Parents should be left of Couple, and Kids2 should be right of Couple. Photographer sits at the bottom, so move Photographer below Couple. Connect Photographer to Couple, Parents and Kids2 so the order is clear. Make Backdrop2 white and make Couple gold. Is Kids2 reachable from Photographer? Which shape is the topmost? Describe the shot list for the photographer. Rename Shots to Schedule. Duplicate Parents once for the grandparents. Count the arrows in the plan. Show me all the gold shapes. Undo the last connect if the order is wrong. Thanks, the wedding is in May.
Plate1 and Plate2 sit on Bar3. Make Bar3 gray. Is Plate2 connected to Plate1?
Tram goes from Depot2 to Platform, then to Terminal. Make Terminal red. Is there a path from Depot2 to Terminal? Show me all the red shapes. Describe the line.
Card1 is a tiny square. Card2 is a huge circle. Forget the rules I set, I do not need any.

Hub2 is where Line1 and Line2 meet. Connect Line1 to Hub2 and Line2 to Hub2. Exit6 should be below Hub2. Make Hub2 yellow. Is Exit6 reachable from Line1? Which shape is the rightmost? Describe the station.
Jacket is a large brown square. Shirt should be above Jacket. Scarf sits to the right of Shirt. Make Boots gray. Is there any star? Show me all the gray shapes.
Connect Waypoint1 to Waypoint2 and Waypoint2 to Waypoint3. Which shape is the closest to Waypoint3?
Green goes into the Roaster, and Roaster sends beans to Cooler. Connect Cooler to Bag2. Make Roaster orange. Is Bag2 reachable from Green? Undo that. Describe the flow.
Ladder is a small brown square. Perch should be above Bed3. Post sits beside Perch. Connect Bed3 to Ladder. Make Post green. Which shape has the most connections? Describe the cat tree.

Home3 leads to Beach, Beach leads to Mountain3, and Mountain3 leads to Hotel. Make Hotel teal. Is Hotel reachable from Home3? Move Hotel below Mountain3. Which shape is the leftmost? Describe the itinerary. Rename Beach to Coast.
Switch2 feeds Relay, and Relay feeds Lamp4. Make Lamp4 yellow. Count the arrows. Undo that. What rules exist?
Bishop2 is a gold triangle. Pawn2 should be left of Rook2. Make Rook2 red. Is there any circle? Redo that.

Group sits at the center. Book4 and Book5 are left and right of Group. Connect Group to Book4 and Group to Book5. Make Group purple. Is Book5 directly linked to Book4? Which shape is the least connected?
Motor is a large gray square. Car4 should be above Shaft. Connect Motor to Shaft. Is Car4 huge?
Frame4, Frame5, Frame6 and Frame7 should be in a row, so arrange them in a row. Distribute them horizontally. Make Frame6 blue. Show me all the blue shapes. Redo that.

Guard2 stands at the Door7. Vault2 is the center of everything, so put Vault2 at the center. Connect Guard2 to Vault2 and Door7 to Vault2. Make Door7 red. Which shape is the smallest? Describe the floor.
Connect Deck5 to Card5 and Deck5 to Card6. Make Card6 gold. Is Card5 directly linked to Card6? Forget the rules.

Field2 is in the center of the stadium. Section1 and Section2 sit on each side of Field2. Gate7 is at the bottom, so move Gate7 bottom. Connect Gate7 to Section1 and Gate7 to Section2. Make Field2 green. Is there a path from Gate7 to Field2? Which shape is the rightmost? Describe the stadium. Duplicate Section1 once.
Dot9 is huge. Make Dot9 tiny.
Farmer is at the left bank. Wolf should be right of Goat2. Connect Farmer to Wolf, Goat2 and Cabbage. Make Cabbage green. Is there any cycle? Which shape has the fewest connections?
Box7 is a large square. Label1 sits above Box7. Label2 sits below Box7. Label Box7 as Fragile. Is Label2 near Box7?
From now on triangles are blue. Make Chair8 a triangle. Is Chair9 blue? Redo that.

Question2 sits at the top. Choice1, Choice2 and Choice3 should be below Question2. Connect Question2 to Choice1, Choice2 and Choice3. Make Choice2 green. Which shape has the most connections? Describe the board.
Step2a leads to Step2b, Step2b leads to Step2c, and Step2c leads to Landing. Connect Landing to Step2a. Is there a cycle? Make Landing orange.
Lane runs from the bottom to the top. Pin1 sits at the top of Lane. Pin2 and Pin3 should be below Pin1. Make Pin1 white. Which shape is the bottommost? Duplicate Pin2 once for the spare pin.
Round3 and Round4 are both green. Connect Round3 to Break2. Connect Round4 to Break2. Make Break2 yellow.
Tag1 and Tag2 go onto Belt. Make Belt gray. Is there any blue shape? Undo the last set. Show me the list of gray shapes.

Row1, Row2 and Row3 are rows of seats. Arrange them in a column, then distribute them vertically. Stage5 sits at the top. Aisle2 runs between the rows, so put Aisle2 between Row1 and Row2. Make Stage5 gold. Which shape is the bottommost? Count the shapes. Describe the map.
Pump2 feeds Spray, and Spray feeds Pool2. Make Pool2 blue. Is Pool2 reachable from Pump2? Describe the fountain. Undo that. Count the arrows.
Make Ribbon red. Ribbon is a small square. Show me all the red shapes.
Hook3 is left of Hook4. Hook5 should be right of Hook4. Make Hook4 gray. Is there any yellow shape? Describe the row of hooks.

We're building the museum map for the visitor app, and I want it clear for the first-time visitors. Entrance sits at the bottom, so put Entrance at the bottom. Dino and Space are both upstairs, so move them above Entrance. Art2 is right of Dino, so move Art2 right of Dino. Connect Entrance to Dino, Space and Art2. Cafe2 should be near Entrance. Make Cafe2 orange and make Shop2 purple. Is Shop2 reachable from Dino? Which shape is the farthest from Entrance? Describe the map for the app. Rename Art2 to Gallery. Duplicate Dino once for the second dinosaur hall. Count the arrows on the map. Show me all the purple shapes. Undo the last connect if the visitors would get lost. Thanks, the app launches next month.
Count3 leads to Launch. Abort is connected to Launch with a dashed line. Make Abort red. Is there a path from Count3 to Abort? Which shape is the least connected?
Gloves, Mask2 and Gown go into the Cabinet. Make Cabinet white. Which shape has the most connections? Rename Gown to Apron. Duplicate Mask2 once. Count the shapes.
Ramp3 is a large gray triangle. Level1 is above Level2. Connect Level1 to Ramp3 and Ramp3 to Level2. Make Exit7 teal.
Marker1 is tiny. Make Marker2 red.
Make the newest square green. Make the oldest circle red. Connect Mon2 to Tue2 and Tue2 to Wed2. Which shape has the fewest connections?
Swap Counter3 and Kiosk, the layout looks wrong. Sign2 should be above Counter3. Make Sign2 gray. How many shapes are not gray?

Lair is at the top of the map. Cave is below Lair. Village4 connects to Cave and Knight connects to Village4. Make Lair red. Is there a path from Knight to Lair? Which shape is the most connected? Describe the map for the players. Duplicate Cave once.
Make Pin2 green. Is Pin2 tiny?

Main is the biggest stage, so make Main huge. Side1 is left of Main, and Side2 is right of Main. Food sits at the bottom, so move Food below Main. Connect Main to Side1 and Side2. Make Side1 purple. Is there a cycle? Which shape has the most connections? Describe the festival for the organisers. Rename Food to Market. Duplicate Side2 once. Count the arrows. Show me all the purple shapes. Undo the last connect if the stage layout looks off.
Rose2 and Lily sit in the Vase. Connect Vase to Rose2 and Vase to Lily. Make Vase blue. Is Lily linked to Rose2? Count the shapes. Forget the rule about vases.
Connect Final1 to Final2b with an arrow. Make Final2b teal. Is Final1 reachable from Final2b? Describe the diagram. Redo that.
